cursor-task.description: Sprint a-9: install the sc-publish release kit, pin it, author release/sc-publish-consumer-input.json, prove release preflight and publish dry-run
cursor-task.deliverables: - Implement every deliverable in the sprint doc (REQ-SAG-0130, 0131, 0132, 0803; ADR-SAG-0017, 0018). - Pin revision: use the local sc-publish clone at the sibling path ../sc-publish (relative to the primary repo root /Volumes/Extreme Pro/github/sc-agent), currently at develop HEAD 11b5b04907aade73599ad2fdabf4562f11f41ea8. Pin that exact 40-char SHA in release/sc-publish-pin.toml. Read plugins/sc-publish/docs/getting-started.md, docs/consumer-preflight-and-docli.md and release/sc-publish-pin.toml.example in that clone before writing anything. - Consumer JSON: workspace crates in publish order (sc-agent-types, sc-agent-secrets, sc-jev, sc-jev-backends, sc-jev-check, sc-treesitter, sc-ai), maturin project sc-jev-py, release_binaries for sc-ai and sc-treesitter, channels crates.io, pypi, homebrew, scoop, winget. - Run install.py (real install, then --dry-run must exit 0). Never hand-edit rendered publish-artifacts.toml / channel contracts / publish-preflight.toml (ADR-SAG-0018). - Secrets naming per kit: PYPI_API_TOKEN (pypi env), TEST_PYPI_API_TOKEN (testpypi env), CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN (repo secret, crates-io env). Document them; do not create them. - docs/development/sc-publish.md: install, pin bump, dry-run drift check, first-release checklist (cargo publish --dry-run order incl. sc-treesitter; maturin build for sc-jev-py; tag/release gate). - .gitignore: .sc-publish-kit/ and .sc-publish-venv/. - Before install.py, move any existing file that collides with a kit path (install.py overwrites silently).
cursor-task.acceptance-criteria: - Every command in the sprint doc Required validation block passes in the worktree (just lint, just test, install dry-run exit 0, run-consumer-preflight.sh exit 0, cargo publish --dry-run --locked for all seven crates, maturin build produces a wheel). - Rendered manifests and workflows include all five channels. - Preflight requirements from the kit hold: [workspace.package].version present, every published crate uses version.workspace = true, members listed literally (no globs), Cargo.lock committed; verify-version-lockstep passes. - release-preflight workflow is present so it runs on the PR. - This sprint does NOT create a tag or perform a production publish. - sprint doc deliverables gate: - `docs/plans/phase-a/sprint-a-9-sc-publish-install.md` exists - sprint doc frontmatter sets `status: complete` - sprint doc frontmatter sets `branch:` - sprint doc frontmatter sets `worktree:` - planning index gate: - `docs/plans/project-plan.md` includes the sprint entry before closeout
